title: OverviewStore query_range uses LIMIT to cap memory — correct bounded materialization
description: overview.rs query_range passes MAX_OVER_RESULTS=10000 as a LIMIT to the SQL query, preventing unbounded result sets when a client requests OVER 1-9999999. The DECISION comment rbe3.7 explains why true row-by-row streaming is deferred. This is the right call at v1: command handlers return a complete Response value, which simplifies testing. Bounding at 10000 rows caps peak memory at about 2 MB. A contributor might suggest removing the limit to support large groups; that would require a redesign of the command loop to support incremental writes.
